rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the philosophical idea that only the self can be known or exists.

example.english: In philosophy, solipsism holds that only the existence of the self can be certain.
example.traditional: 喺哲學上，唯我論主張只有自我嘅存在先至可以確定。
example.jyutping: hai2 zit3 hok6 soeng6 wai4 ngo5 leon6 zyu2 zoeng1 zi2 jau5 zi6 ngo5 ge3 cyun4 zoi6 sin1 zi3 ho2 ji5 kok3 ding6

rows.note: Use this for self-centeredness or being absorbed in oneself without considering other people's views or needs.

example.english: Their solipsism makes them completely ignore other people's feelings.
example.traditional: 佢做事完全唔理人哋感受，呢種自我中心真係令人頂唔順。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 si6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 jan4 dei6 gam2 sau6 ne1 zung2 zi6 ngo5 zung1 sam1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 ding2 m4 seon6
